title: Pepperoni Pizza
ingredients: pizza dough; pizza sauce; pepperoni; mozzarella cheese; ground black pepper; fresh oregano; flour; tomato sauce; kosher salt; ground black pepper; granulated garlic; granulated onion; red pepper flakes; olive oil; softened butter; honey
instructions: Preheat the oven to 500°F: If you are using a pizza stone, preheat it in the oven for at least 20 minutes so it is nice and hot as well. 1. Make the sauce: If you are using my sauce recipe, stir together the ingredients. The sauce recipe makes just enough for one large pizza. You can easily double it if you are making more than one pizza. 2. Roll out the dough: Roll out dough on a lightly floured surface. If it's hard to roll, let it rest for 5 minutes so it can come to room temperature. For a large pizza, I like to roll my dough into about a 14-inch diameter circle. 3. Add the toppings: Transfer the dough to a lightly dusted pizza peel. Alternatively, fit it into a large cast-iron. Add sauce in a light layer all over the pizza, leaving about 1/4-inch crust around the edges. Chop half of the pepperoni and sprinkle it over the sauce. Top the pizza with grated cheese and the rest of the pepperoni. Season with black pepper. 4. Cook the pizza: If you're using a pizza stone, carefully slide pizza into the center of the preheated pizza stone. Cook for 6 minutes, then rotate the pizza halfway so it cooks evenly. Cook for another 6 to 8 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and charred in spots. If you're using a skillet, press the dough into a cast iron skillet and add toppings. Place the skillet over a high heat burner for 2 minutes to get it preheated and get the crust cooking right away. Then transfer to a 500°F oven and bake for 10 to 12 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown. 5. Slice and serve: Use pizza peel to slide pizza out onto a cutting board. Let the pizza rest for a minute and slice into pieces. Season with fresh oregano (optional). Serve while warm with a side salad. 6. Make the honey butter (optional): Stir together the softened butter and honey, then serve alongside the pizza for crust dipping. Store leftover pizza in the fridge for up to three days. Reheat pizza in a sturdy skillet over medium heat with a drizzle of oil. Cover skillet with a lid and cook until the cheese has melted and crust is crispy.

title: Chicken Curry
ingredients: olive oil; small onion; garlic; curry powder; ground cinnamon; paprika; bay leaf; grated fresh ginger root; white sugar; salt; skinless boneless chicken breast; tomato paste; plain yogurt; coconut milk; lemon; cayenne pepper
instructions: 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Sauté onion until lightly browned. 2. Stir in garlic, curry powder, cinnamon, paprika, bay leaf, ginger, sugar, and salt. Continue stirring for 2 minutes. 3. Add chicken pieces, tomato paste, yogurt, and coconut milk. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes. 4. Remove bay leaf, and stir in lemon juice and cayenne pepper. Simmer 5 more minutes. 5. Serve hot and enjoy!

title: California Sushi Roll
ingredients: water; uncooked short-grain white rice; rice vinegar; white sugar; salt; nori seaweed sheets; imitation crabmeat; avocado; cucumber; pickled ginger
instructions: 1. Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees F (150 degrees C). 2. Bring water to a boil in a medium pot; stir in rice. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until rice is tender and water has been absorbed, 20 to 25 minutes. 3. Mix rice vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl. Gently stir into cooked rice in the pot and set aside, uncovered, to let the rice cool. 4. Lay nori sheets on a baking sheet. 5. Heat nori in the preheated oven until warm, 1 to 2 minutes. 6. Center 1 nori sheet on a bamboo sushi mat. Use wet hands to spread a thin layer of rice on top. 7. Arrange 1/4 of the crabmeat, avocado, cucumber, and pickled ginger over rice in a line down the center. 8. Lift one end of the mat and roll it tightly over filling to make a complete roll. Repeat with remaining ingredients. 9. Use a wet, sharp knife to cut each roll into 4 to 6 slices

title: Homemade Ramen
ingredients: sesame oil; grated ginger; grated garlic; broth; water; dried shiitake mushrooms; instant noodles; chopped scallions or chives; chopped kale or spinach; shredded carrots or bok choy; Sriracha; panko crumbs
instructions: 1. Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium low heat. 2. Add the garlic and ginger; stir fry for 2 minutes or until soft and fragrant. 3. Add the broth and the water. Bring to a simmer; add the mushrooms and simmer for 10 minutes or until the mushrooms have softened and the broth is flavorful. 4. Add the instant noodles to the hot liquid and simmer for an additional 5 minutes or until the noodles have softened. Add the scallions and stir to combine. 5. Remove from heat, stir in the kale and carrots, and top with crunchy panko crumbs (see notes) and a soft-boiled egg (optional). 6. Season with chili oil, hot sauce, sesame oil, and/or soy sauce and salt to taste.

title: Fried Rice
ingredients: dried shiitake mushrooms; peanut oil; eggs; scallions; carrot; garlic; red chile flakes; fresh ginger; soy sauce; toasted sesame oil; cooked long-grain rice; cooked pork or ham or beef or chicken; frozen peas
instructions: 1. Soak the mushrooms in boiling water for about 20 minutes, drain, squeeze dry, and quarter them. 2. Heat peanut oil in a wok and cook the eggs until set, then remove and cut into pieces. 3. Stir-fry scallions, carrots, mushrooms, garlic, chile flakes, and ginger. 4. Add soy sauce, sesame oil, and cooked rice and stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes. 5. Add the meat, peas, and cooked egg and stir until heated through

title: Fresh Pasta Noodles
ingredients: all-purpose flour; kosher salt; eggs; egg yolk; olive oil; water
instructions: 1. Beat the eggs, egg yolk, and olive oil together. 2. Combine flour and salt in a food processor and gradually add the egg mixture. 3. Process until the dough forms a smooth ball. 4. Transfer to a floured surface and knead until smooth. 5. Wrap the dough and let it rest for 30 minutes before rolling and cooking.

title: Crunchy Fried Chicken
ingredients: whole chicken; kosher salt; brown sugar; baking powder; all-purpose flour; cornstarch; garlic powder; onion powder; paprika; cayenne pepper; buttermilk; hot sauce; eggs; vegetable oil
instructions: 1. Cut the chicken into pieces and season with salt, brown sugar, and baking powder. 2. Refrigerate the chicken for at least 3 hours. 3. Mix flour, cornstarch, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cayenne, and salt. 4. Mix buttermilk, hot sauce, and eggs separately. 5. Coat the chicken in the flour mixture, then buttermilk, then flour again. 6. Refrigerate the coated chicken for at least 30 minutes. 7. Fry the chicken in hot oil until golden brown and fully cooked. 8. Transfer to a rack to drain.

title: Pan-Seared Pork Chops
ingredients: water; kosher salt; maple sugar; ice; bone-in pork chops; black pepper; olive oil; unsalted butter; fresh thyme
instructions: 1. Make a brine by boiling water, salt, and maple sugar, then chill it with ice. 2. Place the pork chops in the brine and refrigerate for 2 hours. 3. Remove the chops, dry them, and season with salt and pepper. 4. Sear the chops in a hot skillet with olive oil until browned on both sides. 5. Add butter and thyme and baste the chops. 6. Roast the chops in a 400°F oven for several minutes until cooked through. 7. Rest the pork chops for 5 to 7 minutes before serving.

title: Pan Seared Steak
ingredients: steak; olive oil or neutral oil; kosher salt; coarse black pepper; butter; garlic; fresh herbs
instructions: 1. Remove the steak from the refrigerator 20 to 30 minutes before cooking. 2. Preheat a pan or cooking surface over high heat. 3. Coat the steak with oil and season with salt and pepper. 4. Place the steak on the hot cooking surface and cook until browned and cooked to the desired doneness. 5. Finish with butter, garlic, and herbs if desired. 6. Let the steak rest before serving.
